description: NaLaHfP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.98 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.44 Å. Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Hf-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.21 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-39°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-39°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.59 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-41°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.51 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Hf and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Hf and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Hf and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom.
